text: dsh-skill-replicate-android-feature 是一个面向 DSH 的 Android 功能迁移技能包，通过在 DSH 的 skills 运行时注册一份技能说明，引导 AI 编程代理以 Android 源项目为依据，将指定功能复刻到其他项目或平台。它要求追踪完整功能入口和关联页面，保持业务逻辑与界面布局、颜色、字号和间距一致，并复用 Android 资源。适合需要把现有 Android 功能移植到目标项目的开发者。使用前需要提供可访问的源项目和目标项目信息；代码未声明 API 密钥或外部服务要求。

dsh-skill-replicate-android-feature registers a DSH skill that guides coding agents through porting an Android feature. It helps trace related pages, preserve behavior and UI details, and reuse source resources. Developers provide the source and target projects.
想把 Android 项目的某个功能完整迁移到另一个项目。
帮我按照 Android 源码复现这个功能的界面和业务流程。
Help me port an Android feature while keeping its UI and behavior aligned with the original.
dsh-skill-replicate-android-feature 的功能「复刻功能链路」：指导代理从 Android 源码追踪功能入口及关联页面，并在目标项目实现对应业务逻辑。通过选择该技能并提供源项目与目标项目来使用。
dsh-skill-replicate-android-feature 的功能「还原界面并复用资源」：指导代理匹配 Android 界面的布局、颜色、字号和间距，并复用源端资源；仅在目标平台不支持原格式时转换。通过技能说明中的复刻要求触发。

dsh-skill-replicate-android-feature README · Replicate Android Feature：[](https://skills.sh/addxing/replicate-android-feature)

An agent skill for reproducing an existing Android feature in another project or platform. It treats the Android implementation as the source of truth and preserves the complete feature path, behavior, UI, and reusable resources.

dsh-skill-replicate-android-feature README · Install：```bash
npx skills add addxing/replicate-android-feature
```

dsh-skill-replicate-android-feature README · DeepSeek Harness：This repo follows the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Skill format. Clone it into a skills directory and it will be auto-discovered:

```bash
dsh-skill-replicate-android-feature README · User-level install (available in all projects)：git clone https://github.com/addxing/replicate-android-feature ~/.dsh/skills/replicate-android-feature

dsh-skill-replicate-android-feature README · Project-level install (current project only)：git clone https://github.com/addxing/replicate-android-feature .dsh/skills/replicate-android-feature
```

DSH hot-reloads the skills directory after cloning; the skill becomes available in new sessions.

Or install it as an official bundle plugin in one line (requires pnpm; restart the web app afterwards):bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:addxing/replicate-android-feature#main"
```

dsh-skill-replicate-android-feature README · Usage：Select this skill using your tool’s skill mechanism, or ask for it by name. Invocation syntax and automatic activation depend on the tool.

Ask your AI coding tool to apply the skill and identify the feature to reproduce:

```text
Use the replicate-android-feature skill to reproduce the favorites feature from the Android source project in the target project.
```

Provide the source and target project locations when they cannot be inferred from the workspace.

dsh-skill-replicate-android-feature README · What It Does：This skill guides an agent to:

- reproduce all Android functionality and business logic
- match all visual elements, including layout, colors, typography, and spacing
- trace and implement every feature entry and related page from the Android source code
- reuse Android resources, converting only formats unsupported by the target platform
- summarize implemented content, main changed files, validation, and remaining gaps or blockers
